code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia, metabolic/lactic acidosis (pH 6.9, low CO₂, high lactate dehydrogenase), anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). Renal dysfunction is indicated by elevated creatinine. Coagulation abnormalities (high INR) are present. These findings suggest severe systemic illness, possibly sepsis with multi-organ dysfunction and respiratory failure. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are urgently recommended.
